instruction: Organize your Thunderbird by setting up three local folders: CLIENTS, INVOICES, and RECEIPTS.

metadata.explanation: This task variation requires creating three local Thunderbird folders named CLIENTS, INVOICES, and RECEIPTS. The evaluator uses the existing check_list function to verify all three folders are created correctly by checking for both the .msf index files and the folder files themselves. The regex patterns ensure proper folder creation in the Local Folders directory.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts filesystem state by running 'ls -R' on the Thunderbird Local Folders directory
Complete coverage: All 3 required folders (CLIENTS, INVOICES, RECEIPTS) are verified
Comprehensive verification: For each folder, checks both the .msf index file and the folder file itself, which correctly represents Thunderbird's folder structure
Regex patterns are well-designed with word boundaries and negative lookaheads to avoid false matches
Logic flow is correct: postconfig captures state -> getter retrieves cached output -> metric validates all patterns
No parameter handling errors (correctly uses type='rule' with check_list)
Will work correctly at runtime with no edge case issues
